map.摇摄快门速度计算器估算追随拍摄运动物体时的推荐快门，依据横向速度求可容忍模糊的快: The panning shutter speed calculator estimates the recommended shutter when following a moving subject, deriving the tolerable blur range from the lateral speed, suited to sports and wildlife photography.
map.推荐快门 ≈ 1 / (焦距 × 角速度 / 10)角速度 ≈ 横向速度 / 距: Recommended shutter = 1 / (focal length x angular velocity / 10), with angular velocity = lateral velocity / distance
map.由物体速度、距离、焦距求视角移动速度。: Derive the angular image velocity from subject speed, distance and focal length.
map.算凝固运动所需快门分母。: Compute the denominator of the shutter speed that freezes motion.
map.：车速 100km/h=27.8m/s、距 20m、200mm：视角速度 = 2: Vehicle speed 100km/h = 27.8m/s at 20m distance with 200mm: the angular image velocity = 27.8/20 x 180/pi = about 79.5 degrees/s, and the recommended shutter = 1/(79.5 x 10) = about 1/795s (1/800s can freeze the near field).
map.：同场景想拖影：用 1/100s 则移动约 0.8°/帧，车体拉出运动模糊，需权: To intentionally blur motion in the same scene: at 1/100s the frame moves about 0.8 degrees, so the car smears with motion blur; weigh whether the subject stays recognizable.
map.为什么看视角速度而非线速度？: Why look at angular velocity instead of linear velocity?
map.传感器记录的是像移动角度，焦距越长视角速度越大、越需快快门；近处物体同理。: The sensor records the angular motion of the image: the longer the focal length, the faster the image moves across the frame and the faster the shutter must be; the same holds for nearby subjects.
map.跟拍能降快门吗？: Can tracking lower the shutter speed?
map.能，反向追拍抵消相对角速度，可用更慢快门凝主体、虚背景，增强动感。: Yes, panning back cancels the relative angular velocity, so a slower shutter can keep the subject sharp and blur the background for a stronger sense of motion.
